_ghi_chu: English glossary entries by id in data/tu-dien.json (videos and ids come from that file). thuat_ngu: English term when the Vietnamese file uses a Vietnamese name. ten_khac: optional other name shown next to the term.

a-b-test.giai_thich: Half the users see the old version, half see the new one; whichever gets better results wins.

a2a.giai_thich: A shared standard that lets one company's agent hand work to another company's agent.

adaptive-learning.giai_thich: A machine learns how you learn: get it right and it gets harder, get it wrong and it goes back to the basics you're missing, like a private tutor.

ai-agent.giai_thich: AI that doesn't just answer, but is given tools to do work for you over many steps, and stops to ask you before anything important.

alert.giai_thich: Each metric has a red line; when the needle crosses it, an alarm rings so the person on call checks right away.

api.giai_thich: The door apps use to send questions over the internet to an AI model and get answers back; most AI apps rent their model through this door.

artifact.giai_thich: A finished piece that opens right next to Claude's chat: a document, slides, a small spreadsheet or a tool you can click.

attention.giai_thich: Each word "looks" at every other word in the sentence and scores which ones matter most to it; this is the heart of today's chatbots.

autoscaling.giai_thich: At peak hours, the system turns on more machines by itself to keep up; if it can't, you see "overloaded, try again later".

backpropagation.giai_thich: The mistake at the output is passed back through each layer of the neural network; knobs that caused more of the mistake get turned more.

benchmark.giai_thich: AI's exam: thousands of questions with answers ready, and every AI takes the same test; each test only measures one skill.

branching-scenario.giai_thich: An exercise where each choice you make opens a different outcome, so you see the consequences for yourself.

chain-of-thought.giai_thich: Telling AI to "think step by step" so it writes out each step before answering; it guesses better and you can check it more easily.

citation.giai_thich: The answer says which document it came from, so you can open it and check.

claude-code.giai_thich: Claude's coding agent: describe a job in plain words, and it writes the code, tests it and fixes bugs.

claude-design.giai_thich: Claude's design tool: chat on the left, canvas on the right; describe it in words and get slides, a landing page or a prototype.

cloud.giai_thich: Big AI doesn't live in your phone; it runs in faraway data centers, reached over the internet.

connector.giai_thich: A bridge that lets AI into Gmail, Google Drive, your calendar or other tools; many connectors run on MCP.

context-window.giai_thich: AI's "desk": it sees whatever is on the desk, and when the desk is full, old sheets get pushed off and AI stops noticing them.

cowork.giai_thich: Claude's AI agent: hand it a whole long task, and it makes a plan and works through it step by step in the cloud.

custom-instructions.giai_thich: A note stuck on your assistant's desk: who you are, whether you want long or short answers, how to talk to you; AI reads it first every time.

dashboard.giai_thich: A screen showing an AI system's metrics: response speed, cost, refusal rate, and how often customers are unhappy.

data-center.giai_thich: Buildings full of server racks with GPUs, where big AI models run; they use as much power as a whole neighborhood.

data-contamination.giai_thich: AI's test questions slip into its training data, so it gets answers right by remembering, not understanding.

debrief.giai_thich: After each simulation practice, looking back at where you went wrong and what you'll do differently next time.

deepfake.giai_thich: AI copying a person's voice and face, even live during a video call.

design-system.giai_thich: Save your colors, fonts and logo once, and everything you make afterwards matches your brand automatically.

distillation.giai_thich: A big model is the teacher, and a small model learns from how it answers; the result is a small, fast, cheap model that's still pretty smart.

drift.giai_thich: The world changes and users ask new kinds of questions, but the AI system stays the same.

elo.giai_thich: A chess-style scoring system: winners gain points, losers lose some, and beating a strong opponent earns more.

embedding.giai_thich: AI places every word on a giant map where words with similar meanings sit close together; that position is the meaning.

error-compounding.giai_thich: Each step being 95% right sounds great, but chain ten steps together and the whole thing is only about 60% right.

eval-set.giai_thich: A set of real customer questions with the answers you want, used to grade an AI product every time you change it or switch models.

evaluation.giai_thich: Rerunning the test set and scoring it before switching models or editing a prompt; it only goes live once it passes.

feedback-loop.giai_thich: Incidents become lessons, and lessons become test questions: questions that caused problems are added to the eval set.

few-shot.giai_thich: Giving AI a few sample examples so it picks up the tone, length and layout you want.

fine-tuning.giai_thich: Extra training for a model that has already learned, using a special set of examples, like taking a job course after high school.

flashcard.giai_thich: Cards with a question on one side and the answer on the other for review; AI can make them from your videos or documents.

goodhart.giai_thich: When a number becomes the goal, it stops measuring well.

gpu.giai_thich: A special kind of chip for running and training AI, lined up by the tens of thousands in data centers.

gradient-descent.giai_thich: Like walking down a mountain blindfolded: feel which way lowers the error most, take a small step, and repeat millions of times.

guardrails.giai_thich: A separate guard layer around the model: it blocks off-topic questions, hides sensitive information and checks answers before they reach you.

hallucination.giai_thich: AI gives a wrong answer that sounds true, because when it doesn't know, it still guesses whatever sounds most likely.

human-in-the-loop.giai_thich: For real actions like sending money, AI only gets things ready, and a person has to click confirm.

input-guardrails.giai_thich: Checking questions before they reach AI: hiding card numbers, staying on topic, blocking trick prompts.

integrated-learning.giai_thich: Learning several subjects at once through a real project, like planning a trip.

interactive-learning.giai_thich: Turning you from a watcher into a doer: answering questions mid-lesson, asking about hard parts, trying your own examples.

interactive-simulation.giai_thich: A small page with buttons, sliders and charts so you can drag, try and see for yourself; AI can build one in seconds.

interpretability.giai_thich: The research field that shines a light into the "black box" to find the concepts inside AI.

knowledge-cutoff.giai_thich: The day AI stopped reading its training data; it knows nothing about what happened after that day.

leaderboard.giai_thich: A table ranking AIs by score; for example, LMArena collects millions of users' votes from blind matches.

lidar.giai_thich: Measuring distance with light: send a laser flash, time the trip there and back, and build a 3D map for AI to read.

llm-as-a-judge.giai_thich: Using an AI as the judge to grade answers against written criteria; fast, but people still need to double-check.

logging.giai_thich: Every question leaves a line in the log: the time, the question with private details hidden, the answer, how long it took and what it cost.

loss.giai_thich: A number measuring how wrong AI is compared with the right answer; the whole learning process is about pushing it down.

machine-learning.giai_thich: Instead of writing rules by hand, you give the machine lots of examples and let it find the patterns itself.

mcp.giai_thich: A shared USB-C-style port for AI: any tool with an MCP server can plug into any AI app that supports MCP.

memory.giai_thich: General things about you that an AI app remembers between chats; you can view, edit or delete them.

mixture-of-experts.giai_thich: A model split into many small experts; each token only calls the few that fit best, so it's big but still fast.

model.giai_thich: AI's "brain"; one company offers small tiers that are fast and cheap, middle tiers that are balanced, and large tiers that are powerful but pricey.

model-collapse.giai_thich: When AI only learns from AI-made data, it gets blurrier over time, like a photocopy of a photocopy.

monitoring.giai_thich: Tracking speed, cost and wrong-answer rates on a dashboard, so you know about problems before customers complain.

multi-agent.giai_thich: Splitting a big job among several agents working together; only worth it when the job splits into independent parts.

multimodal.giai_thich: AI that takes in text, images and sound in one brain, because everything gets cut into tokens.

mang-no-ron.giai_thich: Thousands of artificial neurons stacked in layers, each layer passing its results to the next.

no-ron-nhan-tao.giai_thich: Takes a few numbers, multiplies them by weights, adds them up and decides; surprisingly simple.

observability.giai_thich: Being able to see clearly inside an AI system, thanks to logs and traces.

on-device-ai.giai_thich: Small models that run right on your phone: no internet needed, your data stays on the device, but they're less smart.

open-weight.giai_thich: A model you can download with all its weights; fully open-source models also share their data and how they were trained.

orchestrator.giai_thich: The agent that makes the plan, splits work among subagents, then puts the results together for you.

output-format.giai_thich: Saying exactly how AI should answer: a table, a checklist, three bullet points, or JSON or CSV.

output-guardrails.giai_thich: Checking answers before they're sent: any careless promises, someone else's information leaked, or missing sources?

overfitting.giai_thich: AI memorizes each training example: nearly perfect on familiar questions, wrong on new data.

pii-masking.giai_thich: Card numbers, phone numbers and ID numbers are replaced with labels before they reach AI.

pretraining.giai_thich: The stage where AI reads a huge amount of text and learns by guessing the next word, repeated billions of times.

project.giai_thich: A private workroom for one task: its own instructions, documents and every related chat, all in one place.

prompt.giai_thich: The message you send AI; include all four parts (role, context, task, format) and AI gets closer to what you want.

prompt-chaining.giai_thich: Splitting a big task into small steps, with each step's result feeding into the next.

prompt-injection.giai_thich: Strange instructions hidden in data, like an email telling AI to send out your contacts, that trick AI into thinking they came from you.

prompt-template.giai_thich: A prompt with blanks to fill in, reused every week and improved after each use.

rag.giai_thich: Letting AI find the right passages in your documents and read them before answering, so it makes things up far less.

reasoning.giai_thich: AI writes a draft first: it breaks the problem into steps and checks itself before answering; slower, but better at hard problems.

red-team.giai_thich: People who play the bad guys and try to trick AI into doing things it shouldn't, so holes get fixed early.

regression-test.giai_thich: A new model has to redo the whole old test and be compared with the current model before it can replace it.

retrieval-practice.giai_thich: Answering questions yourself helps you remember longer than rereading many times.

rlhf.giai_thich: AI writes a few answers and people score which is better; helpful, honest answers get rewarded, made-up ones lose points.

role.giai_thich: Telling AI to play a specific role so it picks the right knowledge and tone; the clearer the role, the better.

role-play.giai_thich: AI plays an interviewer, customer or partner so you can practice conversations like they're real.

scaling-law.giai_thich: Push up the knobs, the data and the computing power together, in balance, and the error drops quite steadily.

scheduled-task.giai_thich: Say it once, "every Monday at 7 a.m., do this", and AI does it on time and lets you know.

self-critique.giai_thich: Asking AI to point out the weaknesses in its own work, then write a better version.

simulation-based-learning.giai_thich: Practicing in made-up situations, seeing consequences right away without fear of mistakes, and repeating until it feels natural.

skill.giai_thich: A recipe card for Claude: the steps and a layout template; when a task matches, Claude takes it out and uses it.

socratic-method.giai_thich: Teaching by asking questions back, so learners work out the answers themselves.

speech-to-text.giai_thich: AI turns sound into a spectrogram picture and reads the shapes into words; double-check names and numbers.

study-mode.giai_thich: A mode where AI gives hints and asks you step by step instead of handing over the answer.

subagent.giai_thich: A "worker" agent that takes one part of the job, has its own context window and tools, and sends back a short summary.

synthetic-data.giai_thich: Data made by AI to teach AI; only useful when filtered carefully and mixed with real data.

system-prompt.giai_thich: Instructions that sit above the whole conversation, like rules AI has to follow for every question.

temperature.giai_thich: The knob for chance when AI draws the next word: low means steady, high means creative but more likely to drift off topic.

text-to-speech.giai_thich: AI turns text into sounds, adds intonation, then makes a sound wave; a few seconds of a voice sample is enough to clone a voice.

thuat-toan-goi-y.giai_thich: Machine learning that uses how long you stop to watch, and what people like you enjoy, to guess which clip will keep you watching longest.

token.giai_thich: The pieces AI cuts a sentence into before reading, each turned into a number; length and price are both counted in tokens.

tool-calling.giai_thich: AI writes a "request slip" (a tool call), the app does the job, then hands the result back for AI to answer.

tracing.giai_thich: Tying all the steps of one question into a single thread, to see what each step received and returned, and where the mistake was.

transcript.giai_thich: A video's speech as text; paste it into AI to turn the video into a lesson.

trong-so.giai_thich: The "knobs" inside AI; learning means the machine turns billions of them itself, a little at a time.

virtual-lab.giai_thich: Doing experiments on a screen, even changing things you can't change in real life; for example, the free PhET library.

voice-clone.giai_thich: AI copying someone's voice from just a short recording; scammers use it to call family members asking for money fast.

voice-mode.giai_thich: Talking with AI out loud like a phone call; it answers in about half a second, and you can interrupt.

zero-shot.giai_thich: Asking with no examples at all, so AI has to guess what you want and gives you an average, safe tone.
